audit.qualification: Selected gate/release controls and ordinary executions. Full gate is separate; no complete platform validation, measured speedup, physical symbol footprint accounting or allocated-symbol authority is established.

mechanisms: lisp.h:Lisp_Symbol holds word-sized value/function/plist; void markers are Qunbound and Qnil
lisp.h:SET_SYMBOL_ALIAS stores the target pointer; eval.c:Fdefvaralias installs it without a duplicate name/target list
data.c:find_symbol_value/set_internal follow redirect then read/write actual fields
pdumper.c:dump_symbol records actual symbol fields and the redirect alternative
deviations: Mutable fields still live in a per-interpreter cell; process-shared allocated symbols are not authoritative yet
The localized-value adapter still distinguishes an absent binding from an explicitly void default through existing enumeration metadata
Value and alias still have separate slots, not the GNU redirect union; original transition tests are preserved without weakening
Ordered ID vectors remain temporary enumeration metadata, with no duplicate name, target or Lisp payload
gnu_reference_review.measurement: Actual cell size 64 bytes is asserted in both gate and release; it is not the full physical symbol footprint or a speedup claim

remaining_validation.full_macos_rust: running separately; no partial run certified here
